title: Audio: voice direction, music choice, SFX palette and placement, mix

entries.do: Every line carries emotion (curious, alarmed, smug, deadpan, tender, excited) and function (hook, setup, list-item, turn, payoff, cta). Map to the engine: Chatterbox exaggeration 0.35 calm / 0.6 engaged / 0.85 shocked, lower cfg for slow loose delivery; Kokoro speed 0.95-1.12 and pauses 0.25-0.5 s by function. Read sentences whole, then cut. Hook is faster and higher, payoff slower and lower with a 0.5 s pause before it.

evidence.note: TTS-like narration at 225 wpm, flat: what we must beat
234 wpm, same flatness; no pause before the payoff

anti_patterns: same speed and pitch on every line
reading a list at one pitch

entries.do: Run tools/audio/prosody.py: pitch range at least 6.5 semitones, loudness dynamics present, pause lengths vary; a flat line is re-read with a changed emotion tag, up to 2 times; otherwise ask the user to record that line.

evidence.note: existing measure of how alive a read is (flat < 4.5, alive >= 6.5)

entries.do: One voice per character, gender matches the character, pitch at least 3 semitones apart, different pace (the mascot quicker and brighter, the human grumbly); 0.15-0.3 s overlap on interruptions; each line tagged with speaker and emotion.

Pick by the average valence/arousal of the beat's lines (tools/audio/mood_pick.mjs) and the style tempo: board 105-112 BPM, split-host 110-115, minion 115-120, flat stickman 120-125, Roblox 120-125, face+overlay 135-145, stickman-3d 140-145, two-faces ambient pad no beat. Bed -22 to -28 dB below the voice, duck 4-6 dB under speech with 120 ms attack and 400 ms release, swell +3 dB on the payoff, stop the beat for the last word before the CTA.

evidence.note: music stem -34.7 dB vs voice -17 dB: bed 17 dB under

entries.do: Hits per 10 s: board 2-3 (on element pops), host+panel 2-3, face+overlay 1.5-6, flat stickman 3-4 (stings on reveals), minion 2-3, stickman-3d 2-3, Roblox 4-6 (whoosh on every cut + stings), two-faces 0-1. Share of hits that sit on a cut: face+overlay about 40 %, Roblox about 70 %.

evidence.note: 36 hits / 57 s = 6.3 per 10 s, 39 % on cuts, mostly whooshes

entries.when: choosing which sound for which event
entries.do: Cut = short whoosh (0.2-0.4 s) starting 40-80 ms before the cut; element pop = soft click or tick; number landing = ding or low impact; reveal = riser then impact on the landing frame; error = short buzz; success = bright chime; typing = key ticks under the voice at -30 dB; each hit within 80 ms of its visual event, gain varied +-2 dB, never the same sample twice in a row, pitch-shift +-1 semitone for repeats.

evidence.note: types measured: whoosh, click, ding; bed -55..-60 dB under the voice, hits peak -21..-30 dB

entries.do: Integrated -14 LUFS (+-1), true peak -1 dB or lower, voice always the loudest element, music never above -18 LUFS short-term under speech, no clipping on stacked SFX (limiter after the sum).

Add tiny room tone (-55 dB), breath sounds before long sentences (-32 dB), light de-ess, a 90 Hz high-pass, gentle 2-4 dB presence boost at 3 kHz, 8-12 ms crossfades between joined takes; no heavy compression; for a device voice band-pass 400-3400 Hz.

entries.when: a read-the-text film with no voice (two-faces)
entries.do: One ambient pad or drone, no beat, mastered to the platform -14 LUFS like every reference (the three silent films measure -14.1 LUFS); a slow swell under the payoff line; a single low heartbeat or breath at the first and last frame; no SFX except a soft tone when the speaker changes.

evidence.note: no speech found (Whisper 0 words); music bed only

entries.do: Only CC0 or licence-recorded sources: our pack, Openverse CC0 audio, Internet Archive CC0 sets, the Wyzowl SFX kit (CC0), generated stings; store licence and URL in assets/manifest; never reuse the reference videos' audio.

evidence.note: Openverse API, Internet Archive SSE swooshes, Wyzowl SFX kit are CC0; verify each file

entries.when: mixing any story short with a voiceover
entries.do: Lock the mix with one linear gain and a peak limiter, no ducking that changes the ratio: music bed at 50 percent of the voice level (about -6 dB, gated RMS), SFX at 50 percent or a little less with peaks capped at 0.7 of the voice peak, master about -14 LUFS with a -1 dBFS peak limiter. SFX sparse (fewer than 8 events per 20 s), none on captions; the music stops on the twist line.

evidence.note: cartoon-audio-short mix.py and Stick3D mix_sfx.py rules
